name: Eternal Hourglass (Combat)
body:
Time is your weapon and your shield.

Prerequisites: Two Eternal Guardian maneuvers known, two Riven Hourglass maneuvers known.

Benefit: Once per encounter, while you maintain a Riven Hourglass stance, you can initiate an Eternal Guardian counter as a free action rather than an immediate action (even if it isn’t your turn).
